purpose: Reusable accounting lifecycle contract for one-time economic income recognition and later settlement/reinvestment states. It formalizes existing Canonical Earned Income View semantics without creating a second income source of truth.

stageSemantics.earned: Economic earning event. Recognition requires canonical mechanism evidence and can occur before claim or receipt.
stageSemantics.accrued: Earned amount accumulated as entitlement or inside a productive position. Accrual may be the first factual recognition point when mechanism evidence proves it.
stageSemantics.claimable: Current claimable state. A balance or first observation is state/baseline and does not itself prove period income.
stageSemantics.claimed: Settlement action. If the same economic income was already recognized when earned/accrued, claim does not recognize it again.
stageSemantics.received: Settlement receipt. If linked to prior earned recognition, receipt preserves provenance and does not recognize a second income event.
stageSemantics.reinvested: Capital-state transition after settlement. Reinvestment can change productive principal/state but cannot rewrite or re-recognize the original earned income.

implementation.settlementExample: 40 Acres veVELO receipts are settlement-only when linked to canonical accrued veVELO income
implementation.scope: Accounting/Historical Truth Foundation v1 prerequisite only; not the later Capital Flow Semantics roadmap layer
